title: TI P4-02: upstream the Pretext blog layout engine (rhythm and feature solver) into Papyrus
description:
## Goal
Upstream the generic, pure-logic part of Threat Intelligence's Pretext blog layout engine into Papyrus so the publication repo needs no layout code. Only modules with no React and no DOM; the components are the next ticket.

## Context (FACT)
- The TI fork (AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence main 9058211, merge base with Papyrus 95df656, 81 commits ahead, 306 behind develop) adds files that do NOT exist on Papyrus develop: lib/blog-rhythm.ts (134 lines), lib/blog-feature-solver.ts (459 lines), plus its tests publications/threat_intelligence/tests/test-blog-feature-solver.cjs and features/blog-rhythm.feature. blog-rhythm exports createThreatIntelligenceRhythm: a TI-specific name for generic vertical-rhythm maths. lib/newspaper-layout.ts, lib/pretext-layout.ts and lib/edition-sections.ts also differ (3, 10 and 9 line deltas in pretext-layout and edition-sections; newspaper-layout is 73 changed lines).
- standard-site.md 3.2 classifies this as "Upstream: Pretext blog layout; largest and riskiest; generic engine into renderers/pretext/; TI header art and obstacles to the brand; component by component".
- Develop's renderers/pretext/layouts.ts already lists "blog" as a layout; develop's presentation-shell.tsx is 470 lines vs the fork's 632.

## Exact steps
1. Worktree of origin/develop. Read the fork files via git show from a shallow bare clone of AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence (fetch main; do not use any existing checkout of another publication).
2. Gherkin first: port features/blog-rhythm.feature and the solver scenarios as observable layout behavior (inputs: text, image sizes, widths; outputs: rows, heights snapped to the rhythm).
3. Add lib/blog-rhythm.ts and lib/blog-feature-solver.ts under their current paths, rename createThreatIntelligenceRhythm to a neutral name (long and clear), keep exports otherwise identical, apply the small lib/pretext-layout.ts and lib/edition-sections.ts deltas only if the scenarios need them.
4. Port the .cjs tests into the Papyrus test location with the same assertions.

## Acceptance checks
- npm run typecheck and the Papyrus JS test suites pass; the new Gherkin scenarios fail before and pass after.
- The ported solver tests produce byte-identical numeric output to the fork's test run for the same inputs (run both, diff the logs).
- No file under publications/ is touched, and no TI-only string remains in the new modules (grep).
- The Papyrus reference brand renders exactly as before (existing layout tests green).

## Rollback
Close the PR; nothing deploys from a Papyrus develop PR.

## Risks
Largest unknown of the phase: hidden coupling to TI brand code (blog-defense obstacles). If a module imports brand code, stop and report instead of widening scope.

## Needs Ryan
PR review and merge into develop only.

## Common rules (Phase 4 Threat Intelligence)
- Plan and facts: the assessment comment on the Phase 4 ticket (PPY-332889). Pattern: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md and docs/standard-site.md 3.2 on origin/develop.
- Ryan: Threat Intelligence is PRE-PRODUCTION; goal is to dogfood the new backend CMS UX before converting anth.us (production). Treat as a hard cutover with brief downtime accepted unless Ryan says otherwise (open question Q1). The OLD app d3on1y5vlrxmam and its backend stay untouched and serving until the retire ticket.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan or on his explicit yes. Read-only AWS calls are fine.
- NEVER use /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us as a build dir. TI repo work: fresh clone under /Users/home/Projects/ (delete afterwards), feature branch + PR, never push to its main. Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus (the board checkout) only run kbs; never git add or commit there.
- Gherkin first for any Papyrus behavior change (AGENTS.md). Long clear names, no line-level comments.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.
